中坛尘埃落定，毒瘴散尽。

满地蛊虫残骸漂浮在死寂黑水之中，五名九菊顶尖养蛊师横尸坛内，蛊王僵硬沉底，原本滔天噬人的万蛊绝阵，在苗疆正统蛊术碾压下，彻底烟消云散。

钱丹收回漫天白蛊，蛊母化作一道白光，重回她袖中蛰伏。她面色微微泛白，气息略有虚浮，连续催动本命蛊虫、强破万蛊大阵，对自身灵气损耗极大。

胡九郎见状，取出一枚纯阳固元丹，随手递出：“调息片刻，稳住心神。”

钱丹点头接过丹药，吞入腹中，纯净道门灵气入体，缓缓抚平紊乱经脉。

众人站在中坛最高石阶，抬眸直视第三重主坛。

主坛地势最高，通体由黑色火山岩堆砌而成，坛面刻满血色献祭纹路，纹路之间流淌暗红血光，无数冤魂虚影在纹路之中沉浮哀嚎，怨气冲天。

祭台中心，嵌着一方深邃地穴，黑洞洞直通地底龙脉主干，暗紫色煞气不断从地穴翻涌而出，顺着祭台纹路流转，被咒法强行抽取、炼化、转化为邪煞本源。

三名身着纯白狩衣的大咒师，分立祭台三角方位，三人手持镇魂木杖，面容肃穆阴沉，口中匀速诵念古老献祭咒文。咒音共振，气场相连，三人之力合一，形成稳固无比的**三角锁龙咒阵**。

半空悬浮的鬼将，身躯魁梧如山，通体由漆黑煞气凝结而成，皮肉粗糙狰狞，肩头缠绕粗大寒铁锁链，锁链另一端钉入虚空，锁住鬼将行动，也锁住整片山巅煞气流动。

鬼将双目赤红，獠牙外露，周身散发碾压级恐怖威压，哪怕相隔数十丈，也让人胸口发闷、道心震颤。

“三名大咒师，三角站位，气场互通，互为犄角，不破三角阵，便断不了献祭咒文。”林佳冷静分析，指尖快速在平板上勾画阵型，“鬼将为空域战力，负责镇守上空，防止我们从高空迂回破阵，同时镇压龙脉外泄清气。”

织田美子被押在后方，此刻面色灰白，低声苦笑：“三位大咒师皆是阴阳寮老牌强者，一人便可抗衡渡边苍玄，三人结阵，咒力叠加，再加上鬼将镇守，这就是阴阳寮压箱底的杀局。你们能破外坛、平中坛，已经创下奇迹，想要硬闯主坛，绝无生机。”

Chapter 95: Three curses lock the dragon, and the ghost will come to the world - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The dust in the middle altar has settled, and the poisonous miasma has dissipated.

The remains of poisonous insects all over the ground were floating in the dead black water. Five of Jiuju's top poisonous cultivators lay in the altar with corpses. The poisonous king became stiff and sank to the bottom. The originally overwhelming and devouring Gu formation completely disappeared under the crushing force of the Miao border's orthodox Gu techniques.

Qian Dan took back the white Gu that filled the sky, and the Gu mother turned into a white light and returned to dormant in her sleeve.Her complexion was slightly pale, and her aura was slightly sluggish. She continuously activated her natal Gu insects and powerfully broke through the formation of ten thousand Gus, which caused a huge loss of her own spiritual energy.

Seeing this, Hu Jiulang took out a Pure Yang Gu Yuan Dan and handed it out casually: "Adjust your breath for a moment and stabilize your mind."

Qian Dan nodded, took the elixir, and swallowed it into his belly. The pure Taoist spiritual energy entered his body and slowly smoothed out the disordered meridians.

Everyone stood on the highest stone steps of the middle altar and looked directly at the third main altar.

The main altar has the highest terrain and is made of black volcanic rocks. The surface of the altar is engraved with blood-colored sacrificial patterns. Dark red blood flows between the patterns. Countless ghosts of wronged souls rise and fall in the patterns, wailing and resentful.

In the center of the altar, there is a deep cave embedded in it. The black hole leads directly to the main trunk of the underground dragon vein. Dark purple evil energy continuously surges out of the cave, flows along the lines of the altar, and is forcibly extracted, refined, and transformed into the evil source by the spell.

Three great spell masters dressed in pure white hunting clothes were positioned in the triangle position of the altar. The three of them held soul-suppressing wooden staffs, their faces were solemn and gloomy, and they recited ancient sacrificial incantations at a constant speed.The sound of the curse resonates, the auras are connected, and the power of the three people unites to form an extremely stable **Triangular Dragon Locking Curse Formation**.

The ghost general suspended in mid-air has a body as tall as a mountain, and his whole body is condensed from dark evil energy. His skin is rough and ferocious. A thick cold iron chain is wrapped around his shoulders. The other end of the chain is nailed into the void, locking the movement of the ghost general and the flow of evil energy on the entire mountain top.

The ghost general's eyes were red, his fangs exposed, and his whole body exuded a crushing level of terrifying coercion. Even if he was dozens of feet away, it would make people's chests feel tight and their hearts tremble.

"Three great spell masters, with triangular positions, interconnected auras, and mutual horns. Unless the triangle formation is broken, the sacrifice spell cannot be broken." Lin Jia analyzed calmly, and quickly sketched the formation on the tablet with her fingertips. "The ghost will be the airspace combat force, responsible for guarding the sky, preventing us from breaking the formation from high altitudes, and at the same time suppressing the dragon veins to leak out the pure energy."

Oda Miko was being held at the back, her face was ashen at this moment, and she smiled bitterly: "The three great spell masters are all veteran strongmen of Yin Yang Liao. One person can compete with Watanabe Cangxuan. The three of them form a formation, the spell power is superimposed, and the ghost generals are guarding it. This is the killing situation of Yin Yang Liao. You can break the outer altar and the middle altar, which has already achieved a miracle. If you want to forcefully break into the main altar, there is no chance."
